options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: can_ip_forward
options.description: Allows this instance to send and receive packets with non-matching destination or source IPs. This is required if you plan to use this instance to forward routes.

options.name: confidential_instance_config
options.description: Configuration for confidential computing (requires setting the machine type to any of the n2d-* types and a boot disk of type pd-ssd).

options.name: deletion_protection
options.description: Whether the resource should be protected against deletion.

options.name: discard_local_ssd
options.description: Discards the contents of any attached Local SSD disks when changing status to TERMINATED.

options.name: disks
options.description: An array of disks that are associated with the instances that are created from this template.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: guest_accelerators
options.description: List of the type and count of accelerator cards attached to the instance .

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname of the instance to be created. The specified hostname must be RFC1035 compliant. If hostname is not specified, the default hostname is [INSTANCE_NAME].c.[PROJECT_ID].internal when using the global DNS, and [INSTANCE_NAME].[ZONE].c.[PROJECT_ID].internal when using zonal DNS.

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to apply to this instance. A list of key->value pairs.

options.name: machine_type
options.description: A reference to a machine type which defines VM kind.

options.name: metadata
options.description: The metadata key/value pairs to assign to instances that are created from this template. These pairs can consist of custom metadata or predefined keys.

options.name: min_cpu_platform
options.description: Specifies a minimum CPU platform for the VM instance. Applicable values are the friendly names of CPU platforms .

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the resource, provided by the client when initially creating the resource. The resource name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with RFC1035. Specifically, the name must be 1-63 characters long and match the regular expression `[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?` which means the first character must be a lowercase letter, and all following characters must be a dash, lowercase letter, or digit, except the last character, which cannot be a dash.

options.name: network_interfaces
options.description: An array of configurations for this interface. This specifies how this interface is configured to interact with other network services, such as connecting to the internet. Only one network interface is supported per instance.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scheduling
options.description: Sets the scheduling options for this instance.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: service_accounts
options.description: A list of service accounts, with their specified scopes, authorized for this instance. Only one service account per VM instance is supported.

options.name: shielded_instance_config
options.description: Configuration for various parameters related to shielded instances.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: status
options.description: The status of the instance. One of the following values: PROVISIONING, STAGING, RUNNING, STOPPING, SUSPENDING, SUSPENDED, and TERMINATED. As a user, use RUNNING to keep a machine "on" and TERMINATED to turn a machine off . Some valid choices include: "PROVISIONING", "STAGING", "RUNNING", "STOPPING", "SUSPENDING", "SUSPENDED", "TERMINATED"

options.name: tags
options.description: A list of tags to apply to this instance. Tags are used to identify valid sources or targets for network firewalls and are specified by the client during instance creation. The tags can be later modified by the setTags method. Each tag within the list must comply with RFC1035.

options.name: zone
options.description: A reference to the zone where the machine resides.
